messages:
maria_sales: Quick sync — we're moving the HealthTech pilot to the technical phase. Need to lock deployment mode (hosted / dedicated / private), region (EU requirement), success criteria, and rough cost/timeline. Can we decide today?

sam_se: Quick notes: if they need data residency + managed keys & audit logs, Private is preferred. If they just need isolation & predictable throughput, Dedicated works. Hosted is fastest to start.

maria_sales: They require data-in-eu and 'customer data never leaves our control' language in SOW. Also likely to sign an annual commit if perf looks good.

oliver_security: Two security checklist items that drive mode choice: 1) KMS/HSM for keys (Private or Dedicated with customer-managed keys). 2) SOC2 + contractual DPA + 3 years of audit logs retention. Hosted can work only if we add contract clauses and EU region hosting.

jess_custsuccess: For acceptance tests we should agree on: curated eval set (500 prompts), latency P95 < 300ms for conversational API, throughput baseline 50 seq/s sustained, and quality baseline: >0.85 F1 on labeled extraction tasks. Also a runbook for fallback to a cheaper model if quality regresses.

sam_se: Proposed pilot plan (3 weeks):
- Week 0: small proof (hosted) to run evals and get quality baseline (2 days)
- Week 1: if they need isolation, spin up Dedicated pool in EU and run scale tests (3 days)
- Week 2: optional Private deployment for legal review + final acceptance (4 days)

sam_se: Quick pricing sketch (very rough): Hosted eval run (~500 prompts) = negligible. Dedicated smoke: ~$8k/mo reserved node for pilot throughput. Private (on-prem bundle + support) = ~$25k one-time + infra. Need finance to confirm.

maria_sales: Customer asked about SLA for Dedicated during pilot — can we offer 99.9% for pilot window?

infra_bot: deploy-bot: note created: could not reserve dedicated capacity without account approval. Ticket #INC-4521

oliver_security: On SLA: we can provide an enterprise pilot SLA but need legal sign-off. Also need to confirm KMS integration timeline (2–3 days).

jess_custsuccess: Acceptance checklist (concrete):
- Eval dataset uploaded to shared S3 in eu-central-1 by Tue EOD
- Run eval script and share precision/recall matrix
- Throughput test: 10k tokens/min sustained for 1 hour
- Latency: P95 < 300ms for 95% of samples
- Security: DPA signed or Priv deployment approved

sam_se: Eval command we plan to run:
```
python run_eval.py --model redwood-3-small --input eval/health_prompts.jsonl --batch 8 --region eu-central-1 --save results.json
```

maria_sales: Customer's main blocker is the legal requirement: "customer data must remain within EU and only our org can control keys." Sounds like Private is the safest long term. But they want quick results this month, so hybrid pilot: start Hosted in eu-central-1 with temporary client-managed keys (if legal ok) then move to Private if legal says no.

oliver_security: Action: I'll take point on the security questionnaire and DPA language. Need answers from the customer about retention windows and whether pseudonymization is acceptable.

jess_custsuccess: I'll own the eval runs and reporting. Will create the result template and lambda for periodic runs.

sam_se: I'll draft infra runbook for spinning Dedicated and the Private installer checklist.

maria_sales: Great. Final asks before we close: 1) finance to confirm pilot pricing range, 2) legal to do quick DPA review, 3) customer to confirm retention + key control. Can we aim for final decision by Fri? :calendar:

oliver_security: I can have the DPA redline ready by Thu EOD.

infra_bot: deploy-bot: scheduled meeting created: Pilot mode decision sync Thu 10:00 UTC. Invite sent.

maria_sales: Perfect — thanks team. I'll follow up with customer and push retention answers.

(End of thread)
